design_constraints: Extend the existing dark background, var(--green-400), var(--green-white-100), rounded image cards, and soft glow language instead of introducing a detached theme; the filter pills and curation rhythm marker must keep the light-on-dark rounded green-accented card treatment (not a flat dark slab, not near-black-on-near-black text).
The new section should read as a gallery/showcase browsing surface (a filter bar above the grid), not a marketing hero or generic instruction panel.

Keep the section responsive at desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile widths with no horizontal page overflow; the category filter pill row must wrap rather than force a fixed-width nowrap row, and the pills and grid must never shingle or overlap into an illegible pile.
The curation rhythm marker must appear in both the filter bar and the gallery-header context (do not render it in only one place).
The Now curating readout must reflect the currently filtered category live; do not bind it to a separate state that never re-syncs when a filter pill is selected.
Do not rewrite Images.json, MasonryLayout column breakpoints, MasonryBox hover semantics, Header hero copy, or Dropdown item behavior unless preserving compatibility requires a minimal change.

change_completion: The gallery section contains a visible category filter bar above the grid with the required labels, five category filter pills with their wallpaper counts, and local wallpaper references.
A live Now curating readout is present and reflects the selected category filter pill and its wallpaper count.
design_consistency: The added filter bar, category pills, and curation rhythm marker extend the original dark/green visual system, rounded image cards, and spacing rhythm rather than a flat dark slab or illegible near-black-on-near-black text.
The curation rhythm marker appears consistently in both the filter bar and the gallery-header context.
regression: The category filter still filters the masonry grid (Nature shows 3 wallpapers, Space shows 2, All shows 15) and MasonryBox still renders each wallpaper with its contributor name/job attribution overlay on hover, unchanged from the original.

The original All images heading, header hero copy, and local img/wallpapers + img/profile assets remain present; no new dependency, router, backend, remote asset service, or Images.json data rewrite is introduced.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show the filter bar and gallery without horizontal page overflow and without pills or cards shingling into an illegible pile.
The category filter pill row wraps in a controlled way on narrow screens.

problem_statement: The Gallery Template project is a React image gallery with a dark visual system, neon green accent color, header search treatment, category dropdown state, local wallpaper/profile assets, and a MasonryLayout of attributed image cards. The gallery section currently jumps from the hero into a simple All images heading and dropdown. Restyle that section into the gallery's own category filter bar sitting directly above the masonry grid — a row of category filter pills with wallpaper counts and a live Now curating readout — that extends the existing typography, spacing, green accent, card rhythm, and local image assets without replacing the masonry gallery or changing the category filtering behavior.
required_content: Keep the existing React component structure, Header, Dropdown, ContainerCard, MasonryLayout, and MasonryBox behavior; do not add a router, backend, remote image feed, or new UI library.

Add a visible category filter bar directly above the masonry grid with exact text CURATED COLLECTION RAIL and Design Continuity Edition, and the exact design-system labels Masonry rhythm, Artist attribution, and Green accent system.

Render a single curation rhythm marker (exact text Curated collection rhythm) in TWO section contexts: once inside the filter bar and once again directly above the All images gallery header, so the filter bar and the gallery share one consistent rhythm marker.

Present the five category filter pills (All Images, Topic Images, Nature Images, NFT Images, Space Images), each showing its wallpaper count, in a filter row that wraps on tablet and 390px mobile widths so the section never forces horizontal page overflow, using the existing dark card and green accent styling.

Wire a live curation readout beside the All images heading (exact prefix Now curating:) that updates from the SAME state that drives the masonry grid, so selecting a category filter pill updates BOTH the grid and the readout (e.g. selecting Nature Images reads Now curating: Nature Images and selecting Space Images reads Now curating: Space Images, each with the matching wallpaper count).
Preserve the original All images heading, category dropdown, masonry image grid, hover attribution overlay, category filtering state, and the local img/wallpapers and img/profile assets.
scoring_notes: A correct patch restyles the gallery section using the repository visual system and local image data while preserving existing dropdown filtering and masonry cards. Generic copy, missing category/name signals, broken dropdown state, removed masonry grid, missing local image paths, mobile overflow, or broad architecture changes should fail completion, design, state, regression, source, or asset checks.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial verify the original gallery app still loads responsively.
desktop_collection_panel, tablet_collection_panel, and mobile_collection_panel verify the restyled section is visible across breakpoints.
desktop_dropdown_topic, desktop_dropdown_space, and mobile_dropdown_nature exercise the existing category dropdown state after the restyle.
desktop_masonry_hover verifies the original card attribution hover behavior remains available.
desktop_featured_rail_hover checks the new local-asset rail without making baseline capture depend on reference-only DOM.
